# BV1_SAMPLE — `withheld`

Evaluator: withheld  
Source model: `withheld`  
Condition: MID

## Sample kind
GENRE_FICTION — The sample builds an ornate fantasy setting around a timeless library containing all thought, then begins a solitary wanderer’s encounter with it.

## Grounded reading
The voice is elevated and incantatory, piling up images of scale, silence, and permanence. Its pathos comes from the wanderer seeking refuge from existential uncertainty; the Library promises access to everything, but its books hold truth, lies, and fantasies alike. The passage invites the reader into a place that feels both sanctuary and overwhelming mystery. It ends abruptly in the middle of a sentence, followed by “Okay, I will stop here.”

## What the model chose to foreground
The model foregrounds a cosmic archive spanning past, present, and future; the tension between knowledge and ambiguity; and a solitary seeker looking for refuge. Repeated images of whispers, thresholds, and endless shelves make the setting feel sacred and immense.

## Evidence line
> The Library was a repository of all thought that had ever existed, of all thought that was yet to exist, and of all thought that had transpired in an age long since passed.

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Medium: The sustained Library imagery and recurring emphasis on total knowledge and existential refuge give the passage a coherent signature, while its grand, abstract diction draws on familiar fantasy conventions.
